law_name: Law No. 21.719 on the Protection and Processing of Personal Data
jurisdiction: Agencia de Protección de Datos Personales
key_requirements: Legal bases beyond consent (contract, legitimate interest); portability; breach notification; DPO/compliance model
enforcement_authority: Personal Data Protection Agency (Agencia de Protección de Datos Personales)
penalties_range: Up to 20,000 UTM (~USD 1.3M) for very serious infringements
deceased_data: Heirs may exercise the data subject's rights after death, but cannot access, rectify or delete the data if the deceased forbade it expressly or a law so provides (art. 4)
research_exemption: Legitimate interest for processing solely for historical, statistical, scientific and public-interest research purposes (art. 16 quinquies); health and biological-profile data may be used for such studies (art. 16 bis)
genetic_data: Genetic, proteomic and metabolic data are sensitive 'biological profile' data, processable only for the purposes of special health laws (art. 16 bis)
notes: Law 21.719 rewrites Ley 19.628, creates new agency; in force 2026-12-01
pending_change: Law 21.719 takes effect and replaces Law 19.628, which applies until then

changes.from: Sensitive data: genetic data (from biological exam) and biological profile data (arts. 16, 16 bis); stricter basis required
